faq.q: Can I arrive directly at Starlite by boat?
faq.a: No. Starlite is located inland at Cantera de Nagüeles, about 3 km from the coast. You'll need to dock back at Puerto Banús or Marbella Marina and take a taxi (€15-20, 10 minutes). We recommend timing your return for 21:30 to allow for the transfer.

faq.q: What's the best boat for a Starlite pre-concert cruise?
faq.a: For couples or small groups, the Azimut 39 (11 pax) at €749/2h is ideal. For larger parties, the Mangusta 80 (12 pax, €4,719/4h) includes a jet ski for added fun. Both depart from Puerto Banús and include drinks and snacks.

faq.q: What time should I start my charter for a 22:00 Starlite concert?
faq.a: Depart at 19:00 from Puerto Banús. Cruise west towards Cabopino or east towards Cala del Faro for sunset views. Return to port by 21:00, then taxi to Starlite by 21:30. This gives you 2 hours on the water plus buffer time.

faq.q: Are drinks and food included in the charter?
faq.a: Yes. Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, and Spanish VAT. You can bring your own food or order a catering upgrade via WhatsApp.

faq.q: Can I book a yacht for the whole day and still attend Starlite?
faq.a: Absolutely. An 8-hour charter (e.g., Azimut 39 at €2,299) lets you cruise to Estepona or Sotogrande, anchor for lunch, then return to Puerto Banús by 18:00. Freshen up, then head to Starlite in the evening.

faq.q: How far is Puerto Banús from Starlite?
faq.a: Puerto Banús is 6 km west of Starlite's venue. A taxi takes 10-15 minutes and costs roughly €15-20. Marbella Marina is even closer at 4 km. Both are convenient for pre-concert charters.

faq.q: What's the sunset like in Marbella during Starlite season?
faq.a: In July and August, sunset is around 21:30-21:45. The sky turns orange and pink over La Concha mountain. A cruise towards Cabopino offers the best views. Temperatures drop to a pleasant 24°C by 20:00.

faq.q: Do I need to book in advance for Starlite 2036?
faq.a: Yes. Starlite is a major event, and yacht charters sell out quickly. We recommend booking at least 2-3 weeks ahead, especially for Tier A boats and the Mangusta 80. Contact us via WhatsApp for availability.

data.body_html:
Starlite 2036 is Marbella's premier summer festival, drawing world-class artists to the Cantera de Nagüeles amphitheatre from July to August. For the ultimate evening, combine your concert ticket with a pre-show starlite marbella yacht charter 2036 from Puerto Banús. Cruise along the Costa del Sol at sunset, sip cava, and arrive at the venue relaxed and stylish. This guide covers boat options, pricing, and timing so you can plan a seamless night.

Why Choose a Pre-Concert Yacht Charter for Starlite 2036?

A pre-concert yacht charter turns a standard night out into a Mediterranean experience. Depart from Puerto Banús at 19:00, head west towards Cabopino or east to Cala del Faro, and watch the sun dip behind La Concha. You'll enjoy champagne, light snacks, and the sea breeze before the music starts. The transfer to Starlite is quick: dock back at Puerto Banús by 21:00, then a 10-minute taxi ride to Cantera de Nagüeles. It's a luxurious, stress-free start to your evening.

Our Fleet for Starlite 2036

We offer boats for every group size and budget, all departing from Puerto Banús. Here's a quick overview of the best options for a pre-concert cruise:

  • Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) – €749/2h or €2,299/8h. Ideal for a small group.
  • Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) – same pricing. Perfect for couples or friends.
  • Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) – €4,719 minimum 4h, includes a free jet ski. For a premium experience.
  • Speedboat (7m, 6 pax) – pricing on request via WhatsApp. Budget-friendly and fast.
  • Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax) – superyacht luxury, pricing on request.

All charters include a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, and Spanish VAT. No hidden costs.

Pricing for Starlite 2036 Charters

Our pricing is transparent. For Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39), the cost is €749 for 2 hours or €2,299 for 8 hours. This covers everything: skipper, drinks, snacks, and VAT. For the Mangusta 80 (both white and grey variants), the minimum charter is 4 hours at €4,719, which includes a free jet ski. For all other boats—like the Canados 86, Fairline Targa, or K80—pricing is available on request via WhatsApp. We recommend booking early for Starlite 2036 as demand is high.

Best Sunset Cruise Route for Starlite 2036

For a 22:00 concert, aim to depart Puerto Banús at 19:00. Cruise west towards Cabopino (about 20 minutes at 20 knots) or east to Cala del Faro. Both spots offer stunning sunset views over the Mediterranean and La Concha. Anchor for 30 minutes to swim or enjoy the drinks. Return to Puerto Banús by 21:00, dock, and take a taxi to Starlite. Total water time: 2 hours—perfect for the €749 option. If you want a longer cruise, the 4-hour Mangusta charter lets you go as far as Estepona and back.

What to Expect at Starlite 2036

Starlite 2036 takes place at Cantera de Nagüeles, a natural quarry amphitheatre with a capacity of 3,200. The lineup typically includes international pop, rock, and flamenco artists. Gates open at 20:00, and concerts start at 22:00. The venue has bars, restaurants, and VIP areas. Dress code is smart-casual; no swimwear inside. After the concert, taxis are plentiful back to Puerto Banús or Marbella's Golden Mile hotels. Combining a yacht charter with the concert means you avoid traffic and start the night in style.

Tips for a Smooth Evening

  • Book early: Starlite 2036 charters sell out by mid-June. Contact us via WhatsApp at least 2-3 weeks ahead.
  • Dress appropriately: Bring a light jacket for the sea breeze (temperatures drop to 24°C by 20:00). Wear comfortable shoes for the venue.
  • Plan your taxi: Pre-book a taxi from Puerto Banús to Starlite (€15-20, 10 minutes). Use apps like Uber or Cabify for convenience.
  • Check the lineup: Starlite announces artists in early 2036. Choose a date that matches your favourite performer.
  • Consider a full-day charter: If you have time, an 8-hour charter (€2,299) lets you explore the coast before the concert.
